source_title: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. Reports Its Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
TAIPEI , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (TWSE: 3711, NYSE: ASX ) ("We", "ASEH", or the "Company"), the leading provider of semiconductor assembly and testing services ("ATM") and the provider of electronic manufacturing services ("EMS"), today reported its unaudited [1] net revenues of NT$244,161 million for 3Q26, up by 44.8% year-over-year and up by 27.8% sequentially. Net income attributable to shareholders of the parent for the quarter totaled NT$26,996 million, up from NT$10,870 million in 3Q25 and up from NT$21,065 million in 2Q26. Basic earnings per share for the quarter were NT$6.13 (or US$0.384 per ADS), compared to NT$2.50 for 3Q25 and NT$4.80 for 2Q26. Diluted earnings per share for the quarter were NT$5.84 (or US$0.365 per ADS), compared to NT$2.41 for 3Q25 and NT$4.61 for 2Q26.
Net revenues from packaging operations, testing operations, EMS operations, and others represented approximately 50%, 11%, 38%, and 1% of the total net revenues for the quarter, respectively.
Cost of revenues was NT$190,194 million for the quarter, up from NT$150,917 million in 2Q26. - Raw material cost totaled NT$116,793 million for the quarter, representing 48% of the total net revenues. - Labor cost totaled NT$23,777 million for the quarter, representing 10% of the total net revenues. - Depreciation, amortization and rental expenses totaled NT$20,664 million for the quarter.
Gross margin increased by 1.1 percentage points to 22.1% in 3Q26 from 21.0% in 2Q26.
Operating margin was 13.6% in 3Q26, compared to 11.1% in 2Q26.
Non-operating items: - Net interest expense was NT$2,611 million. - Net gain on foreign exchange hedging activities was NT$1,176 million. - Net gain on equity-method investments was NT$190 million. - Other net non-operating income was NT$813 million, primarily attributable to miscellaneous income. Total non-operating expenses for the quarter were NT$432 million.
Income before tax was NT$32,710 million in 3Q26, compared to NT$25,696 million in 2Q26. We recorded income tax expense of NT$4,831 million for the quarter, compared to NT$4,171 million in 2Q26.
Net income attributable to shareholders of the parent was NT$26,996 million in 3Q26, compared to NT$10,870 million in 3Q25 and NT$21,065 million in 2Q26.
Our total number of shares outstanding at the end of the quarter was 4,488,092,493, including treasury stock owned by our subsidiaries in 3Q26. Our 3Q26 basic earnings per share of NT$6.13 (or US$0.384 per ADS) were based on 4,403,114,522 weighted average number of shares outstanding in 3Q26. Our 3Q26 diluted earnings per share of NT$5.84 (or US$0.365 per ADS) were based on 4,532,143,664 weighted average number of shares outstanding in 3Q26.
Net revenues were NT$151,485 million for the quarter, up by 51.0% year-over-year and up by 20.1% sequentially.
Cost of revenues was NT$105,073 million for the quarter, up by 35.4% year-over-year and up by 14.6% sequentially. - Raw material cost totaled NT$40,974 million for the quarter, representing 27% of the total net revenues. - Labor cost totaled NT$20,013 million for the quarter, representing 13% of the total net revenues. - Depreciation, amortization and rental expenses totaled NT$19,131 million for the quarter.
Gross margin increased by 3.3 percentage points to 30.6% in 3Q26 from 27.3% in 2Q26.
Operating margin was 20.0% in 3Q26, compared to 15.7% in 2Q26.
Net revenues were NT$93,469 million, up by 35.4% year-over-year and up by 42.1% sequentially.
Cost of revenues for the quarter was NT$85,676 million, up by 36.8% year-over-year and up by 43.0% sequentially. - Raw material cost totaled NT$76,221 million for the quarter, representing 82% of the total net revenues. - Labor cost totaled NT$3,698 million for the quarter, representing 4% of the total net revenues. - Depreciation, amortization and rental expenses totaled NT$1,289 million for the quarter.
Gross margin decreased by 0.6 percentage points to 8.3% in 3Q26 from 8.9% in 2Q26.
Operating margin was 3.3% in 3Q26, compared to 2.4% in 2Q26.
Equipment capital expenditures in 3Q26 totaled US$2,104 million, of which US$991 million was used in packaging operations, US$1,067 million in testing operations, US$41 million in EMS operations and US$5 million in interconnect materials operations and others.
Total unused credit lines amounted to NT$457,283 million as of September 30, 2026.
Current ratio was 1.16 and net debt to equity ratio was 0.66 as of September 30, 2026.
Total number of employees was 119,346 as of September 30, 2026, compared to 114,558 as of June 30, 2026.
Our five largest customers together accounted for approximately 46% of our total net revenues in 3Q26, compared to 44% in 2Q26. One customer accounted for more than 10% of our total net revenues in 3Q26.
Our top 10 customers contributed 63% of our total net revenues in 3Q26, compared to 60% in 2Q26.
Our customers that are integrated device manufacturers or IDMs accounted for 46% of our total net revenues in 3Q26, compared to 41% in 2Q26.
Our five largest customers together accounted for approximately 70% of our total net revenues in 3Q26, compared to 58% in 2Q26. Two customers each accounted for more than 10% of our total net revenues in 3Q26 individually.
Our top 10 customers contributed 78% of our total net revenues in 3Q26, compared to 69% in 2Q26.
ASEH is the leading provider of semiconductor manufacturing services in assembly and test. The Company develops and offers complete turnkey solutions covering front-end engineering test, wafer probing and final test, as well as packaging, materials and electronic manufacturing services through USI with superior technologies, breakthrough innovations, and advanced development programs . With advanced technological capabilities and a global presence spanning Taiwan, China, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Mexico, and Tunisia as well as the United States and Europe, ASEH has established a reputation for reliable, high quality products and services.
For more information, please visit our website at https://www.aseglobal.com .
